messages:
Ethan Park: Hi folks, quick onboarding snag. HR emailed me for a background check and asked for proof of citizenship. Im currently traveling and only have a photo of my passport on my phone. Is it okay to upload that now? Also Ill be on a short trip next week and need VPN access from another country  any blockers?
Nia (People Ops): Welcome Ethan :wave: For the background check, you can upload a scanned passport photo to our secure HR portal (https://hr.redwood/upload) from your personal device, but prefer not to email it. Make sure youre on a private network. If youre uncomfortable uploading while traveling, bring the physical document to office and HR will collect it in person.
Ethan Park: Got it. Is using the HR portal from public Wi-Fi okay if I use cellular VPN?
Rafi (Security): Dont use public Wi-Fi without a trusted VPN. If possible, use your phones mobile data or tether. For international VPN: Okta + device posture required; we allow connections from most countries but some high-risk regions are blocked. Also enable Okta Verify (authenticator) instead of SMS when abroad.
security-bot: Security training assigned: "Security Essentials (Onboarding)" due in 72h. PhishSim exempt for 7 days after account creation.
Ethan Park: Thanks. One more: will uploading my passport to HR portal store it in cloud backups? Im worried about residency docs staying around.
Nia (People Ops): HR portal stores docs in our encrypted HR bucket with retention rules. We only keep ID docs for the period required by the vendor/background-check policy and they'll be purged per retention schedule. If you want confirmation of deletion, ping HR and we can provide ETA.
Rafi (Security): If you need a short-term VPN exception while traveling, DM me with dates and well review posture and grant a time-limited token. Please state device type and whether its company-managed.
Ethan Park: Perfect, DMing details now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Nia (People Ops): Welcome aboard  ping us if anything else pops up.
